- name: a
  quote: {amount_micros: 2000000, currency: USD, unit: target-hour, source: 'operator:a', observed_at: '$FRESH_START', valid_until: '$FRESH_END'}
- name: b
  quote: {amount_micros: 1000000, currency: USD, unit: target-hour, source: 'operator:b', observed_at: '$FRESH_START', valid_until: '$FRESH_END'}
